## Fix agent gating for human-authored PRs

Discussion around the current behavior in
https://github.com/ascerra-fullsend-lab/human-pr-fix-test where the fix
agent is still triggering on PRs authored by humans. The expectation is
that the agent should only auto-fix PRs opened by bots or other agents.

Decision: add a label check — if PR has `human-authored` label, skip the
fix agent entirely. This avoids false positives where the agent rewrites
intentional human changes.

Next steps: implement label gating in the workflow trigger conditions.

## String reversal utility

The string reversal utility tracked in
https://github.com/ascerra-fullsend-lab/human-pr-fix-test/issues/3 was
discussed. Current implementation only handles ASCII. Need to support
Unicode grapheme clusters (e.g. emoji sequences).

Options considered:
- Use ICU4C via FFI — heavy dependency
- Use Go's `golang.org/x/text/unicode/norm` — lighter
- Accept ASCII-only for v1 and iterate

Decision: go with ASCII-only for v1, file follow-up for Unicode support.

## CI pipeline reliability in fix-agent-test

The CI matrix in https://github.com/ascerra-fullsend-lab/fix-agent-test
has been flaky on the `ubuntu-latest` runner. Tests pass locally but
intermittently fail in Actions due to race conditions in the test harness
setup.

Options:
- Add retry logic to the test step
- Increase timeout and add explicit waits
- Refactor test harness to use sequential setup

No final decision — needs more investigation. Agreed to file an issue to
track the flakiness.

## .fullsend configuration updates

Brief mention of updating the scribe agent schedule in
https://github.com/ascerra-fullsend-lab/.fullsend to run less frequently
during weekends. No action item — just awareness.
